divider.$description: Divider's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--divider-<name>) on the page or a container, and everything inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

label-color.$description: A label in the line (4.5:1 on surface).

label-gap.$description: Space on each side of a label (12px).
